non_claims: C24 amide versus C3 ester linkage is not resolved (Garcia 2022; Garcia 2025); the motif covers both, with esters only at C3.
Isomeric amino acids of one formula (valine, norvaline, 5-aminovaleric acid; leucine, isoleucine; 2- and 4-aminobutyric acid) are not resolved by these ions.
Hydroxyl positions, stereochemistry and oxo versus hydroxy cores are unresolved.
The hydroxyl count is claimed only under [M+H]+; under [M+H-H2O]+ an oxo or dehydro conjugate is isobaric with a hydroxy hypothesis, so the count is not claimed there.

notes: Bile acids conjugated to C4-C6 amino acids give the protonated amino acid and the dehydrated core pair; one paper with three synthetic amide standards supports it, and the amide versus C3-ester linkage stays open.
